## Is your feature request related to a problem?

A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. "I'm frustrated when..."

## Describe the Solution You'd Like

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Educational Value

Explain how this feature would improve the educational aspect of the project. What concepts would it help demonstrate?

- [ ] Concurrency patterns
- [ ] Queue management
- [ ] Error handling / retry logic
- [ ] Monitoring / observability
- [ ] System design concepts
- [ ] Other: ___

## Describe Alternatives You've Considered

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Proposed Implementation (Optional)

If you have ideas about how this could be implemented, share them here. Include any relevant:
- Architecture changes
- New dependencies
- API changes
- UI mockups

## Additional Context

Add any other context, screenshots, or references about the feature request here.
